title: Use OnPush with explicit reactive state
statement: Set ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush on application components and express derived view state with signals or computed values. Do not rely on mutation that requires broad implicit change-detection passes.
rationale: Quality Studio's large code and review surfaces need predictable rendering costs. OnPush plus explicit reactive state makes updates local and performance behavior inspectable.

examples.bad:
@Component({ selector: 'qs-panel', templateUrl: './panel.html' })
export class Panel { total = 0; }

history.change: Initial Angular change-detection seed grounded in Quality Studio components.
